# AllCode

> > AllCode is an AWS Partner providing cloud migration, mobile app development, AI/ML integration, and serverless architecture solutions.

AllCode specializes in AWS cloud services including Parse Server migrations, Amazon Bedrock AI agents, data analytics with Athena and Redshift, and containerized deployments. The company offers expertise in mobile development for iOS and Android, along with AWS Well-Architected Framework implementation and certification guidance.

## Key Topics

- AWS (Amazon Web Services)
- Parse Server Migration
- Mobile App Development (iOS/Android)
- Amazon Bedrock AI Agents
- AWS Data Lakes & Analytics
- Container Management (App Runner)
- Elastic Beanstalk
- Node.js Backend Services
- MongoDB Migration
- AWS Certification
- Machine Learning Integration
- Serverless Architecture
- Ethereum/Web3
- Native vs Hybrid Apps
- AWS Well-Architected Framework

## AWS Cloud Services & Migration

- [Parse Server Migration Service - AllCode - AWS Partner](https://allcode.com/parse-server-migration): AllCode Parse Server migration service to AWS with Node.js support
- [AWS App Runner](https://allcode.com/aws-app-runner): AWS App Runner container management with auto-scaling and deployment
- [AWS Data Lake and Data Analytics for SMBs](https://allcode.com/aws-data-lake-and-data-analytics-for-smbs): AWS Data Lakes with Athena, Redshift, EMR for SMB analytics use cases
- [AWS Well Architected Framework Elastic Beanstalk Metrics](https://allcode.com/aws-well-architected-framework-metrics-for-elastic-beanstalk-allcode): Elastic Beanstalk monitoring metrics for AWS Well Architected Framework
- [Which AWS Certification Should You Get?](https://allcode.com/aws-certification): AWS Certification guide covering exam paths and AWS Skill Builder training

## AI & Machine Learning

- [Building an Agent with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore + Strands Agents](https://allcode.com/building-an-agent-with-amazon-bedrock-agentcore-strands-agents): Production-ready AI agent build with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Strands
- [Online Advertising with Artificial Intelligence](https://allcode.com/online-advertising-with-artificial-intelligence): AI benefits in online advertising with AWS machine learning integration
